summary: Illustrative example: October focused on tax compliance and payouts. Hosts can now collect tax information once and reuse it across expenses, and PayPal payouts no longer need a manual reconnect when a token expires.
Behind the scenes, the team finished moving payout reconciliation to the new ledger and cut test suite time by a third (opencollective/opencollective#8123).

shipped.title: Reuse submitted tax information across expenses
shipped.summary: Payees fill in their tax form once; hosts see the stored information on every later expense.

shipped.title: Automatic PayPal token refresh for payouts
shipped.summary: Expired PayPal connections refresh on their own, so hosts no longer reconnect before paying expenses.

shipped.title: Expense list filters remember their state
shipped.summary: Filters on the host expense list persist when moving between pages.

shipped.title: Faster test suite
shipped.summary: API tests run in parallel shards, bringing CI from 24 to 16 minutes.

shipped.title: Security fixes
shipped.summary: Fixes for issues reported through the security program, deployed in October.

inProgress.summary: Moving payout reconciliation to the new ledger so balances match processor reports.
